title: Staff Business Intelligence Data Analyst
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Staff Business Intelligence Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor who takes end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional analytical initiatives that shape decisions at the executive level. This role sets the standard for technical excellence across the analytics team, defining metrics frameworks, data modeling practices, and governance standards while serving as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders and a key contributor to Jamf's AI-enabled analytics strategy.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Drive strategic impact by leading analytical roadmaps and initiatives that align with Jamf's long-term goals. Identify high-impact opportunities, cut through ambiguity on critical initiatives, and represent the data function in leadership forums.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional analytical projects, from scoping and stakeholder alignment through to delivery.
  • Partner with senior leadership and functional analysts as a trusted analytical advisor across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, translating business questions into scalable data products and delivering insights that shape decisions.
  • Set the standard for metrics definition, data modeling, data storytelling, and analytical best practice across the team. Lead the design of scalable data infrastructure and workflows using tools such as dbt, and maintain a high bar for code quality and system design.
  • Lead cross-departmental initiatives that grow data literacy across Jamf, including developing enablement resources, running training sessions, and embedding data-driven thinking into how teams operate.
  • Contribute to roadmap and vision planning alongside Business Intelligence leadership.
  • Mentor analysts at all levels, accelerating their technical and business growth, and foster a culture of autonomy, constructive feedback, and continuous learning.
  • Own data quality and governance by driving the health, integrity, and discoverability of Jamf's data assets, leading stewardship practices, maintaining the data catalog, and ensuring data is trusted across the organization.

What we are looking for:

  • 8+ years in data as an analyst, engineer, or scientist, including 6+ years working with large-scale (1B+ row) cloud data warehouses and 6+ years using business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or DOMO. (Required)
  • Expert-level SQL and 4+ years building data models within a modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake, or equivalent), including layered modeling, testing, performance optimization, and cost management. (Required)
  • Strong analytics engineering and data system design across databases, schemas, marts, aggregates, and views, including 4+ years extending and maintaining a data model system to serve multiple business use cases, with the ability to architect scalable, future-proofed solutions and set technical direction for a team. (Required)
  • Demonstrated ownership of large, complex, cross-functional analytics projects from scoping through delivery. (Required)
  • Experience with data access and security practices both within and outside of a data warehouse. (Required)

PREFERRED

  • Experience building multi-quarter analytical roadmaps or leading organization-wide data initiatives.
  • Experience introducing a new tool, technique, or pattern to a team, with measurable productivity or quality improvements.
  • Familiarity with SaaS business metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, NRR, and product usage analytics.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence and build consensus across functional teams, including without direct authority, from a data model review to an executive presentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a strategic mindset that cuts through ambiguity and connects analytical work to broader company objectives.
  • Ownership and autonomy: identifies gaps, drives work to completion at a high quality bar, and grows data capability across the team through mentoring.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, technology, mathematics, a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Relevant certifications in data, analytics, or cloud platforms (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, or a major cloud provider) a plus. (Preferred)

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Mental Well-being
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News
  • We know that big ideas can come from anyone, so we empower everyone to make an impact. Our 90% employee retention rate agrees!
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • Our volunteer time off allows employees to support and give back to our communities.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.
